title: Microsoft Teams: new sharing panel in meetings
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the roadmap target from Microsoft's announced rollout windows and correctly reports the default-on experience without a tenant-level off switch. The content sharing path and corrected PowerShell command are documented; panel-specific licensing and configuration gaps are appropriately qualified.

claims.quote: The sharing panel in today’s meetings is the default place for content discoverability and sharing.

claims.claim: The planned interface is intended to modernise and simplify tasks such as window sharing.

claims.where: controls[1].scope; Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: Screen sharing mode is a per-user policy controlling desktop and window sharing in Teams meetings.
claims.quote: This setting is a per-user policy. The setting controls whether a user can share a desktop and window in a Teams meeting.

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The Entire screen setting permits full desktop and application sharing.
claims.quote: Entire screen | Full desktop sharing and application sharing are allowed in the meeting.

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Single application allows application sharing, subject to the browser exception stated in Scope.
claims.quote: Single application | Application sharing is allowed in the meeting. If your users are using Teams in a web browser and are assigned this value, this setting functions as Not enabled.

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The disabled sharing option turns off screen and application sharing.
claims.quote: Not enabled | Screen sharing and application sharing turned off in the meeting.

claims.claim: In Teams in a web browser, Single application functions as Not enabled.
claims.quote: If your users are using Teams in a web browser and are assigned this value, this setting functions as Not enabled.

claims.claim: ScreenSharingMode accepts SingleApplication, EntireScreen and Disabled for application-only sharing, full-screen sharing and prohibited screen sharing respectively.
claims.quote: Set this to SingleApplication to allow the user to share an application at a given point in time. Set this to EntireScreen to allow the user to share anything on their screens. Set this to Disabled to prohibit the user from sharing their screens.
